hints.title: Consecutive Vertical Segments
hints.text: Group points sharing the same x-coordinate and consider adjacent y-coordinates as potential rectangle edges.

hints.title: Matching Left Edge
hints.text: For two points (x, y1) and (x, y2), check if both y1 and y2 were seen previously at the same earlier x-coordinate.

hints.title: Range Maximum Query
hints.text: Use a segment tree over compressed y-coordinates to verify no points fall in range [y1, y2] strictly between x-coordinates.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Sweep-line over vertical segments and segment tree over compressed y-coordinates checking empty interior bounds.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all candidate point pairs takes quadratic time, failing on 2 * 10^5 points.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) segment tree and coordinate compression structures.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Combines sweep-line processing with range query structures over y-coordinates.
